scripts.server:clean: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); try { const pids = execSync('lsof -ti:3001', {encoding: 'utf8'}).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean); if (pids.length) { console.log('Killing processes on port 3001:', pids.join(', ')); pids.forEach(p => { try { execSync('kill -9 ' + p); } catch(e) {}}); } } catch(e) {}" && npm run server
